plan_summary: Implement user authentication with JWT tokens across 3 tasks

tasks.title: Create User entity and repository
tasks.objective: Define the User JPA entity and Spring Data repository for authentication
tasks.boundaries: Only create the model layer — no service or controller code
tasks.acceptance_criteria: User entity has id, email, passwordHash, createdAt fields. UserRepository extends JpaRepository.

tasks.title: Implement JwtService for token generation and validation
tasks.objective: Create a service that generates and validates JWT access tokens
tasks.boundaries: Use io.jsonwebtoken (JJWT) library only. No controller code.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: generateToken(user) returns valid JWT. validateToken(token) returns true for valid tokens.

tasks.title: Create AuthController with /api/auth/login endpoint
tasks.objective: Expose a REST endpoint that accepts credentials and returns a JWT
tasks.boundaries: POST /api/auth/login only. No registration endpoint in this task.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 with token. Invalid credentials return 401.
